tasks.title: Build the in-app notification region
acceptance: C1 `src/renderer/src/notifications/index.ts` exports `NotificationKind`, `NotificationRequest`, `Notifier`, `NotificationProviderProps`, `NotificationProvider`, `useNotify` and `NOTIFICATION_TEST_IDS` with exactly the names, types and values the frozen `contracts/notifications.ts` declares. At 7489152 the directory does not exist (`ls src/renderer/src/notifications` fails).

C2 A test under `src/renderer/src/notifications/` renders `NotificationProvider` with an explicit `autoDismissMs`, calls `notify({ kind: 'error', ... })`, advances fake timers by ten times `autoDismissMs`, and asserts the error item is still in the viewport.
C3 A test asserts an `info` notification is present after `autoDismissMs - 1` ms of fake time and absent after `autoDismissMs` ms.
C4 A test asserts a `success` notification is present after `autoDismissMs - 1` ms of fake time and absent after `autoDismissMs` ms.

C5 A test asserts two `notify` calls with the same `key` leave exactly one item in the viewport, carrying the second call's message and `data-kind`, at the first item's DOM position when another item sits after it.
C6 A test asserts `dismiss(key)` removes the item with that key and leaves every other item, and a second test asserts `dismiss` with a key no live item carries does not throw and changes nothing.

C7 A test asserts every item, for each of the three kinds, holds a native `<button type="button">` whose accessible name is `Dismiss notification`, that it is not inside the message element, and that clicking it removes that item only.

C8 A test asserts the message element of an `error` item has `role="alert"`, and of `info` and `success` items has `role="status"`; that its `textContent` equals the message exactly; and that its first child is a `Text` node whose `data` is the message.

C9 A test asserts each item carries `data-kind` equal to its kind and an `aria-hidden="true"` marker whose text differs between the three kinds (frontend discipline, Accessibility floor: "Color is never the only carrier of meaning"; precedent `src/renderer/src/helm/Notice.tsx:18-23`).

C10 A test asserts the provider renders exactly one element with `data-testid="notification-viewport"` and `aria-label="Notifications"` when no notification has been raised, and that it comes after the provider's children in document order.
C11 A test asserts `useNotify()` called in a component rendered outside any `NotificationProvider` throws an `Error` whose message contains `NotificationProvider`.
C12 A test asserts the `Notifier` returned by `useNotify()` is the same object (`Object.is`) across a re-render of its caller.
C13 A test asserts that after four `info` notifications without keys, three remain and the first one raised is the one gone.
C14 A test asserts that with one `error` live, four further `info` notifications leave the error in the viewport.

C15 A test asserts an `info` notification is still present after `autoDismissMs` ms of fake time while the pointer is over the viewport (`mouseEnter`), and is removed once the pointer has left and `autoDismissMs` further ms pass.
C16 A test asserts an `info` notification is still present after `autoDismissMs` ms of fake time while focus is on one of its dismiss controls.
C17 A test asserts `notify` of each kind leaves `document.activeElement` unchanged.
C18 A test asserts that activating the dismiss control of the first of two items moves focus to the remaining item's dismiss control.
C19 A test asserts that activating the dismiss control of the only item moves focus to the viewport element.
C20 A test asserts that after unmounting the provider with an `info` notification live, `vi.getTimerCount()` is 0.

C21 Every `.module.css` file under `src/renderer/src/notifications/` has a styles test beside it that reads the file as text and asserts it references only tokens the `TOKENS` map in `src/renderer/src/contracts/renderer-theme.ts` names (precedent: `src/renderer/src/pods/PodsChrome.styles.test.ts:48`).

That suite censuses every renderer module stylesheet, and its full-window-scrim test pins exactly four scrim rules (`hygiene.test.ts:1500-1505` at 7489152), so a viewport that is a full-window overlay fails it.

tasks.title: Write the human checks for the region and run the final gate
acceptance: C1 `docs/human-checks/message-alerting.md` exists with numbered checks, each with steps and an expected result, that cover what jsdom cannot show: where the viewport sits in the window and that it covers no Pod tab.
C2 It has a check that an error showing while the New Pod or Delete dialog is open is drawn above the dialog scrim.
C3 It has a check that an info or success notification leaves on its own and an error stays until dismissed.

C4 It has a check that a long error message is shown whole and the Pod tab titles keep their width while it shows. The check names the backlog request it settles by its session and its own words (session `20261110-1857-chrome-alert-width`, the request to measure an open-error or pods-error alert shown together with a long reorder alert), never by a `.sir/backlog.md` line number, because Gate 3 removes that row; and it says the measurement is moot because no alert remains in the tab-header row. Evidence: `grep -c 'backlog.md:' docs/human-checks/message-alerting.md` prints 0.
